sample.rule: per land type select the median-area plot; ties/order resolved by plot_id
sample.scope_reason: micro-instance adopted after the 18-plot stratified probe produced no eta=0 second-stage incumbent within 30 seconds; preserves all six land types and the 0.6-mu greenhouse scale
sample.demand_scaling: full 2023 crop production proxy multiplied by sample/full annual land-season capacity

formulation.rolling_policy: three-year look-ahead; commit first year; final two windows shrink to two and one year
formulation.pure_profit_objective: economic profit minus 1 yuan per active crop-plot-season combination
formulation.pareto_objective: minimize waste subject to adjusted profit >= (1-eta)*Pi_star
formulation.bean_rotation: sum of bean area over each three-year window >= plot area, including 2023 observed area
formulation.rotation: conservative year-adjacency prohibition; smart greenhouse also prohibits same crop in both seasons of one year

solver.profit_floor_numeric_slack: max(0.0001 yuan, 1e-9 * abs(Pi_star)); solver feasibility only

predeclared_selection_rules.eta: geometric knee on normalized final profit-loss and waste-reduction curve; retain interval if knee is unstable in joint checks
predeclared_selection_rules.alpha: start at 10%; move upward only if each step reduces activations by at least 10%, adds at most 1% incremental profit loss, and has zero hard-constraint violations
predeclared_selection_rules.joint: candidate pair plus immediate eta/alpha grid neighbors only
